name: The Ridgeback
description: Act 1, "Beyond the Ridge" and after: the second region, south-west of Touchdown. A long spine of rock runs north to south east of the landing site, crossed by two passes. A layered precursor ruin crowns the spine (E1 continued, `ridge-ruin`), guarded by a sleeping relic grid (`spine`: E2 Handshake for anyone who skipped Touchdown's). The richest deposit and both isotope seams lie beyond the spine, so expanding means holding a pass; packs come from the east. Suggested hooks: a site trigger at `ridge-ruin` (layers of ruins, one on another's bones), `north-pass` / `south-pass` for "hold the pass" objectives, and `ridge-view` for a look east.

sites.label: Layered ruin on the spine (E1 deeper)
